cand.title: Donald Wasylenki Education Day 2027
cand.organizationName: University of Toronto Department of Psychiatry

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Commercially relevant organizer contacts, not verified contracting buyers: Dr. Shaheen Darani and Dr. Csilla Kalocsai are named DWED co-chairs in the 2026 award profile; Darani is also Director of Faculty Development and Mentorship and chaired the 2026 event. Dr. Joey Jovana Martinovic is explicitly Chair, Poster Session, DWED 2027. Co-chairs are appropriate relationship and planning referrals; the poster chair is a secondary routing contact. No source establishes hotel purchasing authority for any of them. Event enquiries: psych.events@utoronto.ca on 2027 registration; facdevcppd.psych@utoronto.ca on the departmental event page.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced 16th Annual Donald Wasylenki Education Day: January 28, 2027, in person, 08:00–14:30, Chestnut Conference Centre, 89 Chestnut Street, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. This is an actual activity date, within the requested horizon, not a publication date. The departmental calendar separately shows a 14:00 finish; the detailed programme and linked registration page agree on 14:30. No officially announced 2028 edition was located; annual recurrence must not be converted into a 2028 date.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown is a plausible future urban day-meeting alternative, not a resort proposition. The officially reported 2026 attendance was 133; that historical audience is below the supplied Admiral Ballroom theatre capacity of about 240, but a plenary plus posters, lunch and concurrent workshops requires a layout and circulation review across multiple rooms. Do not treat 133 attendees as 133 guestrooms or a 2027 forecast. The local departmental audience and 08:00–14:30 format suggest a meeting-led rather than residential opportunity, but overnight origin data are unpublished. There is no substantiated 15–109-room block, exclusive-house demand or room-night forecast. Do not promise hotel catering until current operational capability is checked.
findings.venueCommitments: 2027 venue is explicitly published: Chestnut Conference Centre, 89 Chestnut Street, Toronto, Ontario. Registration specifies Ballroom, 2nd floor; Giovanni Room, 2nd floor; University Room, 3rd floor. This is in Toronto proper, downtown near City Hall, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. It is a University of Toronto conference venue, not an edition-specific hotel commitment. Published venue selection is verified; an executed contract was not available.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified recent sequence: February 8, 2024 — Li Ka Shing Knowledge Institute; January 30, 2025 — McCain Complex Care & Recovery Building, 1025 Queen Street West, Toronto; January 29, 2026 — Chestnut Conference Centre, Toronto; January 28, 2027 — Chestnut Conference Centre, Toronto, announced. This demonstrates changes among institutional venues, not a published destination-rotation policy or hotel rotation. The old URL ending education-day-2025 now displays 2027 content, so it was not used to establish the historical 2025 venue.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, hotel room block, hotel booking link or open hotel RFP was found in the reviewed 2027 departmental programme, event calendar or registration page. Hotels listed for this edition: none found. This is absence of published evidence, not proof that lodging is unnecessary or available to bid. The positive venue statement is: "Location: Chestnut Conference Centre. 89 Chestnut St, Toronto ON"; registration says "All members of the Department including trainees and staff are encouraged to attend and registration is FREE." Neither statement establishes accommodation sourcing.
findings.organizationStructure: Event owner/organizer is the University of Toronto Department of Psychiatry, an academic department, not an independent association or commercial agency. DWED is its faculty-development programme, supported by an internal planning committee. The 2027 workshops are offered in partnership with the Centre for Faculty Development. Chestnut is the venue; Eventbrite handles published registration. No external PCO, DMC, housing bureau or hotel buyer was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: 2027 main meeting space is already assigned to Chestnut, including named rooms. Chestnut states: "All events at The Conference Centre are serviced exclusively by our in-house catering team; external catering vendors are not permitted." Thus on-site catering is not an accessible external-hotel supply path under the venue’s published policy. Registration warns: "Space is limited due to capacity at the venue. We will not be able to accomodate walk-ins or anyone who has not registered." This is an attendance restriction, not evidence of hotel overflow, sold-out guestrooms, unmet lodging demand or an open alternate-venue requirement.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send a short planning enquiry to psych.events@utoronto.ca, copying facdevcppd.psych@utoronto.ca, asking for the operational venue/procurement lead working with DWED co-chairs Shaheen Darani and Csilla Kalocsai. Acknowledge that January 28, 2027 is booked at Chestnut. Ask first whether any out-of-town speaker or attendee lodging is required, who books it, and whether any hotel arrangement already exists. Separately ask about the next uncommitted edition’s venue eligibility, decision timetable, attendance, poster footprint, concurrent rooms and budget. Present a future meeting proposal only after those answers and internal catering/AV checks; no speculative block or displacement pitch.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low accessibility for the principal 2027 meeting/catering opportunity because an institutional venue and specific rooms are announced. Lodging remains unconfirmed, not confirmed committed to another hotel and not confirmed open. Speaker/VIP rooms or a separate small meeting could be explored only after organizer confirmation; no such requirement is currently published. Do not displace the confirmed venue or market this as an active accommodation lead.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship-development opportunity, not a sourced future RFP. The organizer explicitly describes DWED as annual, with a documented 2024–2027 sequence and historical institutional venue changes. Ask whether external commercial venues are eligible for the next uncommitted cycle and when evaluation begins. No 2028 date, venue-selection window, hotel budget or willingness to leave university/hospital premises is verified. A Harbourfront venue should compete on an evidenced meeting solution, not presumed convention overflow or resort appeal.
